'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Jonathan Murray LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Jonathon “Throdo” Murray LS Watch Your Step / smuggler ships. (WYS package via EBO-adjacent clone adjusted in note; archetype WYS.)

* '''Player:''' [[Jonathan Murray]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
